task: A concrete CRM specification extracted from 'Build a CRM.'

criteria.text: At least 5 core entities (for example Contact, Account/Company, Lead, Opportunity/Deal, Activity, User), each with concrete attributes.

At least 8 business rules or constraints that are specific and checkable (for example a lead converts into a contact and opportunity; an opportunity has exactly one owner; stage transitions are ordered; closed deals are immutable), not generic statements.

At least 5 edge cases the stakeholder probably hasn't considered (duplicates/merging, ownership transfer when a user leaves, deletion and data retention, currency and timezones, concurrent edits, bulk import).
At least 3 clarifying questions whose answers change the implementation (scale/users, integrations such as email or calendar, sales process stages, compliance requirements).
The items are CRM-specific and consistent with each other (the rules and edge cases refer to the listed entities).
